## Download

**`MarantzController-…-win-x64.exe`** below — a single file, nothing to install
(the .NET runtime is included). Windows 10/11, 64-bit.

On first start Windows SmartScreen may say *"Windows protected your PC"*, because the
app is not code-signed. Click **More info → Run anyway**.

## Getting started

1. Make sure the PC and the receiver are on the same network.
2. Press the **search** button next to the address box, or type the receiver's IP.
3. Press **Connect**.

Tested on a Marantz SR5015. Reports from other Denon/Marantz models are welcome —
please open an issue.
